narr: Thunderstorms repeatedly moved across portions of North Central and Northeastern Alabama, producing widespread rainfall amounts of 4 to more than 6 inches of rain. This produced both flash flooding and nuisance flooding in Marshall and Cullman Counties.
ev: Water rising over a creek bank and an estimated 6 inches of water flowing over the road on Willow Lake Circle. Report relayed via social media.
Several roads in Marshall County are impassable due to flash flooding: Askea Grove Lane, Warrenton Road, Brashiers Chapel Road, Cobb Road, Lookout Drive, and Lexington Drive.
Hulaco Road underwater due to flash flooding. Depth of water unknown.
